title: Japan internet giant GMO says hackers posted stolen customer data
script:
Japan internet giant GMO Internet is verifying customer data posted online by hackers.
Suspected cybercriminals leaked the information following a security breach in cloud services.
The Tokyo based corporation discovered the unauthorized access and launched an immediate internal investigation.
Security teams are working to confirm whether the published files contain genuine customer records.
Will GMO Internet upgrade its security to prevent future data leaks?
